$comment: Demo model manifest. The .step files themselves are NOT in git (see .gitignore) — run `npm run fetch:models` to download them from the upstream source below. Checksums pin exact revisions so a fetch is reproducible.

rebot.name: reBot-DevArm
rebot.description: Seeed Studio open-source 6-axis developer robot arm. OSHWA certified (CN000024).

models.label: Camera Mount (9 parts)
models.note: 2020 aluminium extrusion rail plus printed adapters. Small, fast, real B-rep — use this one for day-to-day iteration.

models.label: reBot B601 Arm — DM (133 solids)
models.note: Full 6-axis arm, direct-drive variant. Nested BOM: 00-ARM_ASM -> 01-BASE_ASM, 02..06-LINK_ASM, 07-GRIPPER_ASM. 36MB — parsing takes a while.

models.label: reBot B601 Arm — RS (136 solids)
models.note: Same arm, rotary-series joint variant. Useful as a second revision of the same product — the rev-survival case.
